params.name: Send to Line: target line info
params.tooltip: On: while you send vehicles to another line with Send to Line, hovering a line on the map also shows its vehicles by model and its capacity, utilization, frequency and rate. Off: the game's hover text only.

params.name: Send to Line: before/after estimate
params.tooltip: On: with "Send to Line: target line info" also On, the hover text shows the line's capacity, frequency and rate as they would be after sending the selected vehicles, marked ~ (an estimate that assumes vehicles of similar speed). Off: current values only.

params.name: Line editor: Undo and Redo buttons
params.tooltip: On: Undo and Redo buttons left of Auto-Rename for the selected line. Undo takes back your last stop edit, Shift+click reverts every edit since you opened the line, Redo brings an undone edit back. Off: no buttons.

params.name: Line list: stats on the color dot
params.tooltip: On: in the Line Manager's line list, hovering a line's color dot also shows the line's vehicles by model and its capacity, utilization, frequency and rate, below the game's tooltip. Off: the game's tooltip only.

params.name: Send to Line list: line info panel
params.tooltip: On: in the list that the Send to Line button opens, hovering a line shows a panel right of the list with the line's vehicles by model and its capacity, utilization, frequency and rate; with "Send to Line: before/after estimate" also On, it adds the values after sending, marked ~. Off: the game's list only.

params.name: Line editor: Line actions button
params.tooltip: On: a Line actions button right of Auto-Rename for the selected line. Duplicate line makes a new line with the same stops and settings, a new color and no vehicles. Reverse line serves the stops in the opposite order, stop 1 staying first (Undo takes it back). Off: no button.

params.name: Map: Shift-click a line opens the Line Manager
params.tooltip: On: Shift-click one of your lines on the map to open the Line Manager on it. With a line window open, Shift-click empty ground or water to manage that line. Works on the plain map and with entity windows open. Off: Shift-click does what a click does.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip: Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Line Manager Plus writes how long its additions to the Line Manager took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]), plus a line per recorded edit. Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
